title: Show plans and credits as videos and images, not only credit counts
gap: components/commercial/PricingClient.tsx:102-104 shows only '<N> credits every month'. Plans & credits (WorkspaceView.tsx) shows a balance and a plan name. Nothing tells a buyer or a producer how many shots that buys.
target: Extend GET /api/plans so each plan carries 'about N five-second 720p videos or M images' for two reference engines, computed server-side with quoteWorkbenchMedia at the platform's defaults. Add a per-engine table (credits per 5 s at each resolution). The Workspace balance line reads '≈ N videos left at your usual settings'.
respects_rules: Read-only figures from the existing quoting function. No promotional banners.
